title: The Wizard of the Emerald City, Part II
overview: The heroes journey to the Purple Country and confront the witch Bastinda.

title: The Old Genie
overview: Moscow schoolboy Volodya accidentally fishes out of the Moscow River a mysterious lamp, from which the genie Khottabych appears. He promises to fulfill any of his wishes, but each of them turns into unexpected consequences. Magic multiplies, rather than solves Volodya's problems. Nevertheless, the schoolboy is imbued with the genie's problems and, as a result, finds himself in the past, where Khottabych's daughter marries an unloved man. Trying to destroy this marriage and free Khottabych, Volodya and his friends go to an ancient Eastern wedding.

title: Umka
overview: Live action adaptation of the soviet cartoon shorts Umka (1969) Umka ishchet druga (1970)

title: Ruby, Ruby
overview: When they awaken a deadly curse, two young women, Ollie and Hannah, find themselves trapped in a haunted cemetery with a malicious predator, thrusting them into a nightmarish battle for survival against evils, both supernatural and human.

title: The Phantom of the Opera
overview: Anastasia, an 18-year-old ballet dancer at the Opéra Garnier, becomes the obsession of a disfigured man living in the opera's underground labyrinth.

title: Old New Former
overview: Once Katya left Pushchino near Moscow to become a pop star, leaving her lover Kolya behind. Now she is a famous singer, leading a bright, bohemian, but empty life, together with her unloved and unloving producer Sasha. Due to an unusual set of circumstances, Katya finds herself in another reality, in which she has a husband, a doctor at a district clinic, two small children and a choice: to find the humanity she once lost in the simplicity of family relationships or to remain a lonely empty shell, in a world where no one will give her sincere warmth and love.

title: Anxious People
overview: On the day before Christmas Eve, investment banker Zara begrudgingly finds herself mingling with a group of strangers at an open house. When a reluctant bank robber inadvertently takes the group hostage, chaos and oversharing ensues, secrets are revealed and literally nothing goes according to plan

title: Ночной гость
overview: The film's protagonist, Olga, returns home unexpectedly early and stumbles upon a surprising scene. From there, things rapidly escalate: a mysterious "night guest" appears, old family conflicts resurface, and the night becomes filled with candid confessions, sudden twists, and utter chaos.

title: Дом ходуном
overview: A construction company threatens to take over an orphanage's land for an amusement park. Borisov hires Polunina to resolve controversial issues, while Chizhikov hires bandits.

title: Life Is Life
overview: An elderly shepherd takes on big business when he becomes the only holdout against property developers building a luxury resort in his tiny Sardinian village.

title: Bunker
overview: When an architect accepts a morally ambiguous project — building a survivalist bunker for a tech billionaire — his wife of 17 years begins to question their relationship.

title: Мороз
overview: New Year's Eve. Two friends steal a third friend's body from the morgue to bury him according to his wishes, only to find themselves suspended between life and death in a winter forest.

title: Artificial
overview: The story of OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, centred on his controversial firing and re-hiring in November 2023, a movement led by co-founder Ilya Sutskever.

title: When The Snow Falls
overview: Young writer Sandra presents her debut novel in Paris. Among the guests, she sees a mysterious stranger who reminds her of the secrets of her past. Seeking answers, she flies to St. Petersburg and discovers a replica of herself, living under a different name.

title: Snow Eight
overview: Mark, a 12-year-old sloppy teenager from a rich family, is sent by his mother from Moscow to Kamchatka to live with his harsh father, Kai, after another scandalous offense. Far from his usual life, the Internet and school friends, the boy finds himself in the world of dog sled racing. Working with animals — the snow eight charming husky dogs — becomes a real challenge for him. Gradually, Mark finds friends — Anya and Petka — and discovers the power of the team, where trust and support are important. And mom and dad have to change their views on raising a child and, most importantly, look at each other with completely new eyes.

title: Neanderthal
overview: Fedor is a famous MMA champion who lost not only his reputation in the sports world, but also his family due to uncontrolled aggression. To change, he decides to go to Altai, but is accidentally transported to the primitive world 10,000 years before BC. The local aborigines mistake him for a warrior who will help them defeat their sworn enemy. Fedor understands that he is a weakling among the aborigines, so in the struggle it is necessary to use not force, but cunning and the ability to negotiate. Together with the shaman's daughter Reba, he goes to his main goal – to return home.

title: Suffocation
overview: In an elite high school swimming team plagued by a sinister curse, five teens unwittingly unleash a chain of deadly events after exposing a forbidden teacher-student affair through a leaked video. As the curse reawakens, they must confront betrayal and despair while racing to uncover the truth and break the cycle of death, only to realize they are destined to become each other’s undoing.

title: Hotel «At the Dead Mountaineer»
overview: Police inspector Peter Glebski arrives at a small mountain hotel, "At the Dead Mountaineer's", after receiving an anonymous letter - the letter warns that a murder will be committed in the hotel. An avalanche that occurs in the evening blocks the only exit from the gorge, and at night Glebski discovers the body of one of the guests...

title: Зов космоса: Битва за Нептун
overview: Fifteen-year-old Alisa, a graduate of the Gagarin Roscosmos Academy, sets off on her maiden interplanetary voyage aboard the *Lomonosov* alongside her father, former combat pilot Nikolai Fyodorov. Their mission is to deliver a quantum chip—created by scientist Andrei Gromov and concealed within an android designated T-17—to a research laboratory on Neptune. This technology, capable of harnessing the inexhaustible energy of a black hole, could pose a threat to the entire universe should it fall into the wrong hands. A powerful adversary from another galaxy learns of its existence; the alien commander Vex tasks a space pirate named Marcus with seizing the quantum chip. The *Lomonosov’s* peaceful mission quickly transforms into a high-stakes race across the entire solar system.
